params.name: channel
params.description: Conversation ID to fetch history for.

params.name: latest
params.description: End of time range of messages to include in results.

params.name: oldest
params.description: Start of time range of messages to include in results.

params.name: inclusive
params.description: Include messages with latest or oldest timestamp in results only when either timestamp is specified.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return. Fewer than the requested number of items may be returned, even if the end of the users list hasn't been reached.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Paginate through collections of data by setting the `cursor` parameter to a `next_cursor` attribute returned by a previous request's `response_metadata`. Default value fetches the first "page" of the collection. See [pagination](/docs/pagination) for more detail.

items.docs: Fetches a conversation's history of messages and events.
